name: ApicHope Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: ApicHope Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pharmaceuticals in China. The company offers pediatric medicines; chronic disease drugs; active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations; and specialty traditional Chinese medicines. It is also involved in scientific research and technical services; wholesale and retail trade; information technology; and technology promotion and application services. The company was formerly known as ApicHope Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd and changed its name to ApicHope Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. in December 2024.
